/*selectBuyerMdCmHistoryGoodsSearchList*/
SELECT DISTINCT S.IMGFILE_NAME, --[01] S.IMGFILE_DIR, --[02] S.BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[03] S.DESCRIPTION, --[04] S.SPECIFICATION, --[05] S.ORIGIN_TEXT, --[06] S.MAKER_NAME, --[07] S.TARGET_QTY, --[08] S.UNIT_MEASURE, --[09] S.UNIT_PRICE, --[10] S.PR_QTY, --[11] S.PR_SUM, --[12] S.PR_SEQ, --[13] S.BUYER, --[14] S.PR_NO, --[15] S.ORIGIN_CODE, --[16] S.CHANGE_DATE, --[17] S.CATEG_ID, --[18] DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}),'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)', S.AGENT_NAME) AGENT_NAME, --[19] S.AGENT, --[20] S.CONTRACT_NO, --[21] S.CONTRACT_SEQ, --[22] S.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, --[23] DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}),'N','KRKORE0001', S.AGENT) AGENT3, --[24] S.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, --[25] S.HS_NO --[26]
FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, A.IMGFILE_NAME, A.IMGFILE_DIR, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.ORIGIN_TEXT, A.MAKER_NAME, A.TARGET_QTY, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.PR_QTY, A.PR_SUM, A.PR_SEQ, A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.ORIGIN_CODE, A.CHANGE_DATE, A.CATEG_ID, A.AGENT_NAME, A.AGENT, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, A.HS_NO
FROM ( SELECT
/*+USE_NL(P C) INDEX(P ICOMPRDT_02) INDEX(P ICOMPRDT_09)*/
MAX(DECODE(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME), NULL, (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=D.IMG_NO),B.IMGFILE_NAME)) AS IMGFILE_NAME,
MAX(DECODE(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR), NULL, (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=D.IMG_NO),B.IMGFILE_DIR)) AS IMGFILE_DIR,
P.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(C.DESCRIPTION) DESCRIPTION, MAX(C.SPECIFICATION) SPECIFICATION, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE)) ORIGIN_TEXT, MAX(C.MAKER_NAME) MAKER_NAME, SUM(NVL(P.TARGET_QTY,0)) TARGET_QTY, MAX(C.UNIT_MEASURE) UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(C.UNIT_PRICE) UNIT_PRICE, 0 PR_QTY, SUM(NVL(P.TARGET_PRICE,0) * P.TARGET_QTY) PR_SUM, COUNT(P.PR_SEQ) PR_SEQ, MAX(P.BUYER) BUYER, MAX(P.PR_NO) PR_NO, MAX(C.ORIGIN_CODE) ORIGIN_CODE, MAX(P.CHANGE_DATE) AS CHANGE_DATE, MAX(B.CATEGORY_NO) CATEG_ID, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT)) AGENT_NAME, C.AGENT AGENT, C.CONTRACT_NO CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ CONTRACT_SEQ, MAX(P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE) BYIT_COMORG_CODE, MAX(NVL(TRIM(B.OVER_SHORT_FLAG),'N')) AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, MAX(TRIM(B.HS_NO)) AS HS_NO
FROM ICOMPRDT P, ICOMCQDT C, ICOMBYIT B, CMSCATLG D WHERE P.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND P.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND P.STATUS != 'D' AND P.ADD_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-12),'YYYYMMDD') AND ( (P.BUYER_ITEM_NO NOT IN (SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'HIST_D' AND CODE2 = P.ADD_USER_ID)) -- 삭제된 품목에 없음 OR (P.ADD_DATE > (SELECT ADD_DATE FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'HIST_D' AND CODE2 = P.ADD_USER_ID AND CODE1 = P.BUYER_ITEM_NO)) ) -- 삭제한 날짜 이후 주문 건
AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_buyer_item_no})||'%'
AND UPPER(P.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'||#{st_description}||'%'
AND UPPER(P.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||#{st_specification}||'%'
AND (UPPER(P.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||#{st_desc_spec}||'%' OR UPPER(P.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'||#{st_desc_spec}||'%')
AND UPPER(P.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%'
AND P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.CMS_CATLG_ID = D.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND D.STD_FLAG(+)='Y' AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = P.BUYER -- 하위 조직코드 추가 AND P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND B.STATUS != 'D' GROUP BY P.BUYER_ITEM_NO , C.CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ , C.AGENT
ORDER BY
BUYER_ITEM_NO
DESCRIPTION
MAKER_NAME
PR_SEQ DESC, PR_SUM
DESC
ASC
)A ) S

/*selectBuyerMdCmHistoryGoodsSearchList_v2*/ SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, D.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT S.IMGFILE_NAME, --[01] S.IMGFILE_DIR, --[02] S.BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[03] S.DESCRIPTION, --[04] S.SPECIFICATION, --[05] S.ORIGIN_TEXT, --[06] S.MAKER_NAME, --[07] S.TARGET_QTY, --[08] S.UNIT_MEASURE, --[09] S.UNIT_PRICE, --[10] S.PR_QTY, --[11] S.PR_SUM, --[12] S.PR_SEQ, --[13] S.BUYER, --[14] S.PR_NO, --[15] S.ORIGIN_CODE, --[16] S.CHANGE_DATE, --[17] S.CATEG_ID, --[18] S.STDCATLG_ID, S.STDCATEG_ID, S.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}),'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)', S.AGENT_NAME) AGENT_NAME, --[19] S.AGENT, --[20] S.CONTRACT_NO, --[21] S.CONTRACT_SEQ, --[22] S.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, --[23] DECODE((SELECT MAX(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG) FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}),'N','KRKORE0001', S.AGENT) AGENT3, --[24] S.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, --[25] S.HS_NO, --[26] S.ADD_DATE, S.MIN_ORDER_QTY, S.PUR_UNIT_QTY, S.MY_ITEM_YN
FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM, A.IMGFILE_NAME, A.IMGFILE_DIR, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.ORIGIN_TEXT, A.MAKER_NAME, A.TARGET_QTY, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.PR_QTY, A.PR_SUM, A.PR_SEQ, A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.ORIGIN_CODE, A.CHANGE_DATE, A.CATEG_ID, A.STDCATLG_ID, A.STDCATEG_ID, A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, A.AGENT_NAME, A.AGENT, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.OVER_SHORT_FLAG, A.HS_NO, A.ADD_DATE, A.MIN_ORDER_QTY, A.PUR_UNIT_QTY, (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BYIT_COMORG_CODE = A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND USE_FLAG = 'R' AND USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS MY_ITEM_YN
FROM ( SELECT
/*+USE_NL(P C) INDEX(P ICOMPRDT_02) INDEX(P ICOMPRDT_09)*/
MAX(DECODE(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME), NULL, (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=D.IMG_NO),B.IMGFILE_NAME)) AS IMGFILE_NAME,
MAX(DECODE(TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR), NULL, (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO=D.IMG_NO),B.IMGFILE_DIR)) AS IMGFILE_DIR,
P.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(C.DESCRIPTION) DESCRIPTION, MAX(C.SPECIFICATION) SPECIFICATION, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE)) ORIGIN_TEXT, MAX(C.MAKER_NAME) MAKER_NAME, SUM(NVL(P.TARGET_QTY,0)) TARGET_QTY, MAX(C.UNIT_MEASURE) UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(C.UNIT_PRICE) UNIT_PRICE, 0 PR_QTY, SUM(NVL(P.TARGET_PRICE,0) * P.TARGET_QTY) PR_SUM, COUNT(P.PR_SEQ) PR_SEQ, MAX(P.BUYER) BUYER, MAX(P.PR_NO) PR_NO, MAX(C.ORIGIN_CODE) ORIGIN_CODE, MAX(P.CHANGE_DATE) AS CHANGE_DATE, MAX(B.CATEGORY_NO) CATEG_ID, MAX(B.STDCATLG_ID) AS STDCATLG_ID, MAX(B.STDCATEG_ID) AS STDCATEG_ID, MAX(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG) AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT)) AGENT_NAME, C.AGENT AGENT, C.CONTRACT_NO CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ CONTRACT_SEQ, MAX(P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE) BYIT_COMORG_CODE, MAX(NVL(TRIM(B.OVER_SHORT_FLAG),'N')) AS OVER_SHORT_FLAG, MAX(TRIM(B.HS_NO)) AS HS_NO, MAX(P.ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE, MAX(C.MIN_ORDER_QTY) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY, MAX(NVL(C.PUR_UNIT_QTY,1)) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY
FROM ICOMPRDT P, ICOMCQDT C, ICOMBYIT B, CMSCATLG D WHERE P.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND P.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND P.STATUS != 'D'
AND P.ADD_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-3),'YYYYMMDD')
AND P.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND ( (P.BUYER_ITEM_NO NOT IN (SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'HIST_D' AND CODE2 = P.ADD_USER_ID)) -- 삭제된 품목에 없음 OR (P.ADD_DATE > (SELECT ADD_DATE FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'HIST_D' AND CODE2 = P.ADD_USER_ID AND CODE1 = P.BUYER_ITEM_NO)) ) -- 삭제한 날짜 이후 주문 건
AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%'
AND UPPER(P.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%'
AND UPPER(P.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%'
AND UPPER(P.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||#{st_keyword}||'%'
AND (P.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(P.DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(P.SPECIFICATION) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%' OR UPPER(P.MAKER_NAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{st_keyword})||'%')
AND P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.CMS_CATLG_ID = D.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND D.STD_FLAG(+)='Y' AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = P.BUYER -- 하위 조직코드 추가 AND P.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND P.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND B.STATUS != 'D' GROUP BY P.BUYER_ITEM_NO , C.CONTRACT_NO, C.CONTRACT_SEQ , C.AGENT )A ) S
ORDER BY S.ADD_DATE DESC )D WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
ORDER BY S.PR_SEQ DESC )D WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
ORDER BY S.ADD_DATE DESC
ORDER BY S.PR_SEQ
ORDER BY S.PR_SEQ DESC
ORDER BY S.DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY S.DESCRIPTION DESC
ORDER BY S.SPECIFICATION
ORDER BY S.SPECIFICATION DESC
ORDER BY S.MAKER_NAME
ORDER BY S.MAKER_NAME DESC
ORDER BY S.UNIT_PRICE
ORDER BY S.UNIT_PRICE DESC
)D
